name: Student visa, with optional RVPO (Temporary Residence Permit for Education)

requirement_groups.name: Admitted to an accredited Russian institution

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an official invitation from a Russian university following admission to a full-time programme (specialist, bachelor's, master's, postgraduate, or doctoral level, or a preparatory/language programme).
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission and an official invitation from an accredited Russian institution.

evidence_required.document: Official invitation letter from the Russian institution
Proof of funds and health/travel insurance
MVD registration within 7 days of arrival

outcome.duration_length: student visa: 90 days initially, renewed annually for the duration of studies; RVPO (where obtained): full course length plus 180 days post-graduation

sources.title: Novika -- Russia Visa 2026: Application, E-Visa, Cost & Times, describing the student visa category and renewal process

GW2RU -- How to get a temporary residence permit in Russia in 2026, describing RVPO (TRPE) as a distinct education-purpose temporary residence permit with post-graduation work rights and a simplified 3-year path to permanent residence

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. STRUCTURAL FINDING: RVPO (razreshenie na vremennoe prozhivanie v tselyakh obrazovaniya, Temporary Residence Permit for Education) is a genuinely distinctive Russian option layered on top of the ordinary student visa -- rather than choosing between a plain student visa or a residence permit, students can additionally apply for RVPO, which grants the right to work during free time from studies without a separate work permit, a materially better position than the plain student visa's restricted work rights. RVPO holders get a simplified 3-year path to permanent residence (VNZh) after graduation, without needing to first hold an ordinary RVP -- a real structural on-ramp captured in switchable_to. Separately, and even more favourably, graduates with a 'red diploma' (summa cum laude honours) from a state-accredited, full-time Russian degree programme can apply directly for VNZh, skipping RVP/RVPO entirely -- see ru_vnzh_permanent_residence for that fast-track group. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of mvd.ru or a Russian government education-visa page was achieved in this research pass; both sources are tier-3 but well cross-referenced and internally consistent, kept as published rather than draft given the consistency across independent checks.
